Dawid Malan's 70(50) & Kamal Airee's 4/26 helped Chitwan Rhinos secure a thrilling 8-run win over Biratnagar Kings!
Andre Russell smashed a brilliant 33(17), but it wasn't enough to take Biratnagar Kings over the line!
